descriptions.cxc3_classify_80200884: If flag bit 4 at +20 is clear and the first twelve-byte record has a nonnull type at +8, scan the external record array at info+28 using count byte info+17. Test equality with the first type and continuity of unsigned short offsets at record+6, advancing by helper 0x80200050 of the first type. OR flags with 6 for equal types or 4 otherwise, plus bit 1 when offsets are consecutive. Preserve all prior flag bits. Meanings of flags and type helper remain inferred.
